# QLX

> Type-safe, schema-first PostgreSQL query builder for Go with zero reflection, static analysis, and native pgx v5.

## Self-Contained AI Specification

- [Full Autonomous AI Context](llms-full.txt): Complete, 100% self-contained reference and grammar rules for AI coding agents. Contains all types (`qt`, PostgreSQL ENUMs, JSON contracts), query patterns, mutation rules, extension helpers, and anti-hallucination checklists without referencing any external files.

## Human Documentation

- [User Guide (English)](docs/GUIDE.en.md): Full tour of the library from setup to production.
- [SQL to Go Grammar Mapping](docs/sql-to-go.md): Complete correspondence table between PostgreSQL grammar and QLX functions.
- [Row Mapping & Scan](docs/mapping.md): Rules for position vs name scanning, `//qlx:row`, and zero-reflection DTOs.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): `qlx.yaml` reference, multi-schema setups, and migrations.
- [Extension Helpers](docs/qext.md): High-level typed helpers for pgvector, PostGIS, text search, and trgm.
